arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 50 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE LOWER(concept_name) = 'endometriosis' ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, vocabulary_id

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND standard_concept='S' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%leuprolide%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%elagolix%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%danazol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%goserelin%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nafarelin%') ORDER BY concept_name

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND standard_concept='S' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%morphine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%oxycodone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%fentanyl%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tramadol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%codeine%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hydromorphone%') AND concept_class_id='Ingredient' ORDER BY concept_name

WITH endo_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 433527
    UNION SELECT 433527
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Condition' AND standard_concept='S' AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%endometriosis%'
),
ablation_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (37396113,4167725,44806981,44806162,4032014)
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (2110241,37396113,4167725,44806981,44806162,4032014)
),
medical_ingredients AS (
    SELECT v FROM (VALUES (1511449),(1560104),(1366310),(1351541),(1500211),(1507558),(1521369),(1343039)) AS t(v)
),
medical_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT v FROM medical_ingredients)
    UNION SELECT v FROM medical_ingredients
),
endo_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM endo_concepts)
),
ablation_events AS (
    SELECT p.person_id, p.procedure_date AS index_date, 'laparoscopic ablation' AS treatment
    FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p
    JOIN endo_patients e ON e.person_id=p.person_id
    WHERE p.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ablation_concepts)
),
medical_events AS (
    SELECT d.person_id, d.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date, 'medical therapy' AS treatment
    FROM omop.drug_exposure d
    JOIN endo_patients e ON e.person_id=d.person_id
    WHERE d.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM medical_concepts)
),
all_events AS (
    SELECT * FROM ablation_events
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM medical_events
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT person_id, index_date, treatment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id, treatment ORDER BY index_date) AS rn
    FROM all_events
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT r.person_id, r.index_date, r.treatment
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id=r.person_id
      AND op.observation_period_start_date <= r.index_date
      AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day,365,r.index_date)
    WHERE r.rn=1
),
pain_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (436096,4034006,440704)
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (436096,4034006,440704,45562109,45542912,45547763)
),
opioid_ingredients AS (
    SELECT v FROM (VALUES (1133201),(1201620),(1154029),(1174888),(1126658),(1103640),(1110410),(1124957),(1125765),(19026459),(1103314)) AS t(v)
),
opioid_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT v FROM opioid_ingredients)
    UNION SELECT v FROM opioid_ingredients
),
outcomes AS (
    SELECT c.person_id, c.treatment,
      MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
        WHERE co.person_id=c.person_id
          AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM pain_concepts)
          AND co.condition_start_date > c.index_date
          AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chronic_pain_12m,
      MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de
        WHERE de.person_id=c.person_id
          AND de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM opioid_concepts)
          AND de.drug_exposure_start_date > c.index_date
          AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opioid_12m
    FROM cohorts c
    GROUP BY c.person_id, c.treatment
)
SELECT treatment,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(chronic_pain_12m) AS chronic_pain_n,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(chronic_pain_12m)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS chronic_pain_pct,
       SUM(opioid_12m) AS opioid_rx_n,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(opioid_12m)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS opioid_rx_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY treatment
ORDER BY treatment;
